identity.description: An attacker uses tscon.exe to hijack an active RDP session, potentially gaining access to a victim's desktop environment. Cortex should detect the execution of tscon.exe with suspicious parameters and network activity related to session redirection.

biocs.name: Suspicious tscon.exe Usage
biocs.description: Detection of tscon.exe being executed with parameters that redirect to console
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'tscon.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/dest:console'

abiocs.name: Unusual RDP Session Hijacking Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of a process attempting to hijack an RDP session using tscon.exe
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'tscon.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/dest:console'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect RDP Session Hijacking via tscon
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'tscon.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/dest:console'
| comp count() by agent_hostname, action_process_command_line
